title: Only way to see Tangier in a day
text: You know that expression, you get what you pay for...this was worth every penny. Abu kept us informed about every step along the way. He arranged a driver to pick us up at our hotel. The driver took us to the port terminal and retrieved our ferry tickets. Abu greeted us in Tangier, right at the door leaving customs. He was so knowledgeable, accommodating and pleasant. I have a tree nut allergy. Abu made sure to let the restaurant staff know and always told what not to eat. The food at both restaurants were delicious! He made the tour as little or as long as we liked. Be prepared, like any tour
author: 239charinc

title: So Glad We Fit This In!
text:
We had limited time during a trip to Spain, but wanted to fit in a trip to Morocco. This was the perfect solution. It was a full day packed with highlights. It included everything we needed to enjoy our trip and not worry about the details. 

Our guide, Abu, was fantastic. He was born and raised in Tangier and speaks fluent English and Arabic (and I’m pretty sure French too) so he easily navigated every conversation for us. He asked us what we wanted to see, we told him, and he made it happen, for example, a snake charmer and hand made scarves.

title: The best part of our trip to Spain
text: I am so glad we paid a little extra for this tour compared to some of the cheaper options. Abu communicated everything clearly and answered our questions quickly. Our driver Chokri was always on time and exactly where he was supposed to be. And our guide in Morocco Mohammed was the star. His knowledge was endless, his English excellent, and as a local he navigated everything smoothly and seemed to be friends with everyone. We saw and did everything we wanted, and we’d definitely do it again.
author: Jimmy_H

title: Wonderful daytrip to Tangier
text: Our Moroccan guide,Ismail was wonderful,friendly and interesting,he told us of life in Tangier,both historical and modern.He has excellent english and was fascinating to talk to. The typical itinerary of museums and tombs was less of interest to our small group than visiting the medina and souk,so Ismail asked our interests and tailored the day to our interests,great.We enjoyed a delicious breakfast of Moroccan pancakes at a spectacular seaside restaurant at Cape Spartel. title: Fun filled trip to Tangier from Sevilla
text: Highlight of the tour was the camel ride on the beach! The camel ride was along the sandy beach and camels took us back up a moderately steep slope. Visiting the casbah was also interesting as well as driving thru the mega mansion area of Tangier. Our guide Mohammed was very knowledgeable and our driver Rafa was helpful.
author: kdcarroll2003

title: Thanks for everything
text: Super excursion. Great service and very friendly. I would repeat and recommend without hesitation.
author: nereal327

title: We had an amazing trip to...
text: We had an amazing trip to Tangier. Our driver was the nicest and even brought drinks for us. Our tour guide was phenomenal. It was a fast paced day and we fit in a lot - riding camels, tasting delicious foods and touring the Kasbah. We enjoyed it so much we are planning a dedicated trip to Morocco.
author: Kristina_J

title: A day well spent!
text: My wife and I enjoyed our day long trip from Sevilla to Tangier. There was a bit of a mix up during our morning pick up. Our hotel was on a narrow street that accessible to vehicles. It was possible to pick us up a short distance away (as other drivers had done for other activities) but our driver asked us to walk a few blocks. We blundered around in the dark and drizzle for a bit before we found him. Not a major problem but worth noting. Our driver went into the ferry office in Terife and retrieved our ferry tickets.
